chunks: And We saved them and their people from the great distress

key_terms.قَوْمَهُمَا: their people (referring to Hud and his companion)

ai.seo_question: Who were saved from great distress in this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the deliverance of Prophet Hud and his believers from the 'great pain' of the flood, a calamity that specifically spared the faithful while engulfing the disbelievers. This event serves as a paradigmatic example of divine justice, illustrating how God preserves the righteous from the consequences of their community's rejection.
